messages:
julia: quick check — i'm drafting a compact RFC about reducing long-lived API keys. idea: reserve a tiny admin keyset, mint short-lived intent tokens for most flows. feedback?

mike: sounds right. main worry is mint latency and metric cardinality. cache minted tokens at the edge for a few minutes.

sarah: agree. policy: map claims -> existing roles (no per-token roles). minted tokens carry claims + parent for audit only.

cory: ops: mint service is critical path. require per-tenant throttles, circuit-breaker, fallback to deterministic claim expansion only for low-risk reads, else deny.

julia: migration plan: shadow-mint on legacy-key use, emit deprecation telemetry, provide SDK auto-mint helpers. target RFC in two weeks.

mike: i'll review telemetry labels to avoid high-cardinality.

sarah: i'll prepare role mapping examples.

cory: i'll draft failure modes and SLOs.

julia: thanks all — i'll publish draft tomorrow and ping reviewers.
